name: keel-registry
description: The registry API: portable persistence (SQLite/SQL Server), the read-only guard, the Dremio gateway.
//: Only ./db and ./dialect are exported. Chartroom builds its own tables on the registry's portable idiom (ADR-4) and needs exactly those two; the API surface, the read-only guard and the Dremio gateway stay private, so the exports map is the boundary rather than a convention.
